name: The random Classic Heroic and Mythic Dungeon Finder queues require the live average item level
contract: The live client allows Random Classic Dungeon Heroic (1258) from average item level 40 and Random Classic Dungeon Mythic (2258) from 58 (C_LFG.RequiredRandomItemLevel), measured as the character sheet's average item level. A join below the requirement is refused and leaves the player out of the queue; a join at or above it queues the player.
